state.objective: A SaaS-focused review and a fresh source-focused review need one ordered outcome. Can should eventually serve a wide range of server and client SaaS applications. The answers here guide a review, not a change to approved grammar or compiler behavior.
state.baseline: The existing language uses frozen nominal data, named callables, written outward failures, declaration-owned tests, distinct AI declarations and grouped AI inputs. Its target compiles to JS/Bun operations with safety glue. No outside adopter needs old spellings preserved; justify major additions by comparing representative Can code.
state.pattern_evidence: The checker and emitted assertions accept a typo in the last union arm because unknown unqualified names bind the whole value. Extending the variant does not expose the error; the properly named three-arm version becomes non-exhaustive. Constructor spelling of the typo fails. Earlier policy kept the bare rule, but this new direct probe challenges that policy.
state.library_evidence: Source libraries cannot hide ordinary record construction and with-updates while exporting the type. Catalogue combinators specialize callback errors, but an authored helper names concrete errors; operational templates are checked at each use without an expressed requirement. Two dependency projects using the same package label or application error number cannot be linked unchanged.
state.fixture_evidence: Changing only the root row name in a consuming package leaves static checking green but stops a helper package's local when-row from activating. The helper then returns actual conversion text rather than injected data. This is not a concurrent queue collision. A previous disposition postponed explicit cross-call scenario links before the repro existed.
state.frontend_evidence: The qualified model serves HTML/HTMX from Bun, with no Can runtime inside a browser. String links between endpoints, form controls and swap targets survive independent renames. An invoice grid with drafts, keyboard behavior, optimistic saving and rollback needs client-side state. Keeping that code in another browser language can still make Can a strong server language, with an honest scope label.
state.delivery_evidence: The release target pins macOS arm64; Linux service behavior is not yet release-qualified. A realistic proof would exercise authorized invoice edits, idempotent provider events, transaction/outbox outcomes, failed dependencies, displayed status and shutdown. Current SQL descriptors enforce shape/cardinality and codecs but do not validate a live schema projection at build time. These are operational gates, not mere syntax preferences.

pattern_policy.instructions: Choose the pattern-intent experiment that most directly restores future-case checking.

criteria.explicit_binding: Introduce a distinct binder form so an unresolved bare case cannot silently bind the subject.
criteria.constructors_only: Make paid() style the nominal test form and use unadorned identifiers only for captures.
criteria.warn_only: Retain ambiguous names but warn when a binding resembles a declared leaf.
criteria.retain: Preserve the earlier retained pattern rule, relying on style guidance for case intent.

value_boundary.instructions: How should a reusable library express an email type whose construction it controls?

criteria.owner_control: Compare package-private representation behind an exported immutable type, specifying factories and codecs together.
criteria.transparent_validation: Treat public data as DTOs; validate again wherever an exported value is consumed.
criteria.catalogue_only: Use compiler-maintained types for invariants; ordinary source records remain publicly constructible.
criteria.defer: Postpone representation control pending evidence beyond email, quantity and tenant identifier.

fixture_scenarios.instructions: Choose a response to the root-label rename changing helper behavior.

criteria.explicit_seams: Evaluate explicit mapping from a root scenario to named dependency fixture seams with the current exact checks.
criteria.lexical_labels: Retain current lexical tables and treat assertion-row naming as an intentional cross-package convention.
criteria.stub_boundary: Use complete dependency substitution at the package edge instead of selecting interior fixtures.
criteria.global_ordinals: Use broad function/ordinal fixture replacement rather than explicit local-site ownership.

generic_errors.instructions: Select the next evidence gate for a general fallible helper such as retry.

criteria.measure_then_trial: Measure current Can's best reusable retry/audit helper, then prototype a written finite set variable only if needed.
criteria.result_permanent: Retain fixed completion signatures and express all reusable variable errors through ordinary result data.
criteria.add_intrinsics: Prefer more language-owned specialized helpers instead of authored error-set abstraction.
criteria.implicit_inference: Let each function's body define its exported failure contract automatically.

frontend_path.instructions: How should Can sequence the current SSR scope and the richer all-frontend ambition?

criteria.server_then_browser: Establish a production server/HTMX recommendation, then add a bounded Can client target proved by local drafts, optimistic updates and disposal.
criteria.browser_first: Lead with client runtime and component architecture while deferring the existing service-language contract gates.
criteria.typed_external_client: Use a supported TypeScript/browser client with generated wire types and position Can as the backend in the full application.
criteria.server_only_universal: Make the universal SaaS frontend claim without adding local browser execution or a separate client stack.
